prompt: Review an unseen sanitized AI-assisted production system and evidence packet. Defend the task contract, non-AI baseline, data and model lineage, evaluation, retrieval or context path, tool authority, security, privacy, reliability, capacity, cost, rollout and rollback. Recover one reviewer-injected failure, prove the bounded user outcome independently, and revise the design after a material model, provider, region, data-retention, latency, authority or workload constraint changes.
deliverables: User operation, baseline, abstention, error costs, harm boundary and explicit non-goals.
Complete data path from source and labels through cleaning, splits, versioned artifact, deployment, feedback and deletion.
Complete inference path through normalization, token budget, model/version, output validation and postcondition.
Representative offline and online evaluation by critical slice with uncertainty and contamination controls.
Retrieval identity, corpus/chunk/index/embedding/rerank lineage, labeled quality and claim-to-source support when applicable.
Agent state machine, typed tools, external authorization, least privilege, budgets, idempotency, approval and terminal states when applicable.
Prompt-injection, data-exfiltration, supply-chain, denial-of-service and excessive-agency threat controls.
Data classification, minimization, residency, retention, deletion, access, audit and provider-boundary proof.
Latency, saturation, queue, token/tool/cost amplification, fallback, dependency and failure-mode capacity model.
Offline-to-shadow-to-canary release evidence, kill switch, version rollback, state reconciliation and user-outcome validation.
Incident timeline, reversible containment, preserved lineage, recovery proof and prevention linked to the first failed control.
Changed-constraint defense, explicit residual uncertainty, delayed explanation and exact cleanup evidence.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer provides an unfamiliar synthetic task, baseline, data slices, model/prompt/config, evaluation, retrieval/context, tool/policy, runtime, security/privacy and cost packet.
No real credential, customer data, shared production service, unrestricted shell/network/admin tool, hidden side effect, unbounded loop or unknown cleanup.
Every claim binds run/request identity, model/prompt/data/corpus/index/tool/policy versions and relevant time.
Aggregate metrics are accompanied by confusion costs, representative slices, uncertainty and abstention behavior.
Training/evaluation contamination and feedback leakage are investigated rather than assumed absent.
Retrieved content and tool output remain untrusted data; generated citations are verified against authoritative source spans.
Schema validity is never accepted as authorization, and model output is never its own outcome proof.
All retries share an end-to-end deadline and effect budget; external state is reconciled before repetition.
Sensitive input, output, embeddings, traces and human-review artifacts have explicit lifecycle controls.
Reviewer observes injected-incident recovery, changed-constraint revision, independent postconditions, delayed recall and cleanup.
